title: Tavern combo in Akron, Ohio, and coming home
summary: Clayton played piano and trumpet in a small combo in Akron and toured Ohio and Pennsylvania before returning to New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: I stayed off and on there. I was around there at 22. I left around, see but I was stationed in the Barberton, Ohio. I had a little tavern job in Akron I was playing every night, 85 East North Street. I played piano and laid my trumpet on the top of the piano. Well I started to ask if there's any other instruments you ever played except your ukulele or all that. Yeah, I played piano too. So I got me a girl who played piano in Wadsworth, she lived in Wadsworth, and her brother played drum well and we made up a little three piece combo, you know, as in Akron, Ohio, right behind the Goodrich Rubber Company.
